dedupe_keys.name: ukceh land cover plus fertilisers england

description: Land Cover plus Fertilisers maps the predicted application rates of inorganic nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium fertilisers in England at 1 km resolution, each with an uncertainty map. The first product (2019, by Osório, Redhead, Jarvis, May and Pywell) gives average annual rates for 2010 to 2015; the second (published November 2025 by Jarvis, Risser, Pywell and Redhead) gives a map per year for 2015 to 2021 in kg per km2 per year. Rates were modelled by spatial interpolation of the Defra British Survey of Fertiliser Practice. The provider lists uses such as modelling nutrient runoff to water, fertiliser greenhouse gas emissions, eutrophication impacts and crop growth. Files are GeoTIFF, ordered from the Environmental Information Data Centre; bespoke licensing applies, and after ordering the UKCEH data licensing team contacts the user to agree a licence. Supporting documents are free to download. Caveats: values are interpolated estimates, not farm records, and England only. For simulation it gives spatial agrochemical inputs, useful to link farming to water quality in catchment and water treatment models and to fertiliser supply shock scenarios. Related catalogue records include the Crop Map of England and the June Survey of Agriculture and Horticulture.
